# Liquidity Hedge

> Measurement and hedging infrastructure for Orca Whirlpool concentrated-liquidity
> positions on Solana. Operated by Blocksventures Ltd, a British Virgin Islands
> business company. Contact: sowelu.avanzo@nortadesyco.xyz

Four services, priced separately. No subscriptions, no bundles.

## 1. Portfolio analytics — free

Read-only dashboard at /app for Orca Whirlpool concentrated-liquidity positions.
Live position value and token split, range and in-range status, uncollected fees,
V(S) payoff curves, portfolio aggregation, and a Viability Index (measured fee
yield against the corridor breakeven, with the estimator and its uncertainty band
stated). Monte-Carlo simulation under three independent models — geometric
Brownian motion, empirical bootstrap of historical returns, and historical replay
— composable over value-only / value+yield / yield-only, with optional stochastic
fee intensity. Non-custodial: never requests a transaction signature, never asks
for a seed phrase. No account required; a public address can simply be pasted in.

## 2. Orca fee-growth dataset, 2026 forward — 1 USDC

The differentiated product.

- Cadence: 15-minute snapshots.
- Coverage: every Orca Whirlpool with 24h volume above 10,000 USDC (~107 pools at
  that threshold); tracked set refreshed daily. Coverage starts 2026-07-26 and
  grows continuously.
- Per snapshot, per pool: feeGrowthGlobalA and feeGrowthGlobalB (cumulative swap
  fees per unit of liquidity since pool genesis, Q64.64 fixed point), the
  liquidity active at the current tick, the decimal-adjusted price, and both
  token vault balances (exact on-chain TVL).
- Delivery: one long-format CSV with a `pool` column, sorted by pool then time,
  RFC-4180 quoted, UTF-8. Fields, in column order:
  pool, pair, t, iso, price, liquidity, feeGrowthGlobalA, feeGrowthGlobalB,
  vaultA, vaultB, decimalsA, decimalsB, tvlQuote, quoteIsUsd.

Why it is unique: fee growth is denominated per unit of liquidity, so the
competing-liquidity division is already applied. That makes the exact,
counterfactual fee income of ANY price range in ANY covered pool computable —
including ranges nobody ever held:

    fees(range, L) = sum over snapshots where price is inside range of
                     (delta feeGrowthGlobal) * L / 2^64

Volume, TVL and APR feeds (Dune, DefiLlama, vendor APIs) cannot do this: they
describe aggregate pool behaviour and do not know how much liquidity sat inside a
given range. Exact for a marginal position; for a large hypothetical L, dilute by
L_active / (L_active + L) using the liquidity in the same row. Range boundaries
crossed between snapshots are resolved at the 15-minute cadence and no finer.

Use cases: LP range-strategy backtesting; impermanent-loss and LP-yield product
pricing; concentrated-liquidity microstructure research; fee-APR model
calibration.

Not included: per-position data, wallet attribution, order flow, individual swap
records, or any price feed other than the pool's own price at the snapshot.

To buy: email the pools and date range wanted. A USDC payment address, the exact
row count and the file size are quoted before payment.

## 3. Historical archive, 2023–2026 — 200 USDC — PRE-ORDER

NOT YET COLLECTED. NOTHING IS AVAILABLE FOR DOWNLOAD.

Available on request only. Would be reconstructed on demand by replaying archived
Solana swap transactions through Orca's fee-accounting rules to rebuild the fee
accumulators, delivered in the same 14-field schema as the forward dataset so the
files concatenate. Indicative delivery 4–6 weeks after order. Reconstruction is
funded once demand is confirmed. Express interest by email; there is no buy
button.

## 4. Liquidity Hedge certificates — invite-only pilot, quoted per position

A 7-day cash-settled bilateral contract replicating the mark-to-market
variability of one concentrated-liquidity position inside its own range:

    payoff = V(S_0) - V(clamp(S_T, p_l, p_u))

Fully prefunded on both sides: the buyer posts premium plus collateral equal to
their capped maximum obligation and can never owe more than they have already
paid. Priced by:

    Premium = max(P_floor, FV * m_vol - y * E[F])

with fair value by numerical quadrature under risk-neutral geometric Brownian
motion, m_vol = max(markup floor, IV/RV), y*E[F] the fee-split discount, and
P_floor a published governance minimum. Full premium breakdown before purchase,
hash-committed term sheet, published treasury and exposure, deterministic
settlement policy.

LEGAL — do not summarise this away:
- Invite-only pilot.
- Blocksventures Ltd (BVI) is the DIRECT COUNTERPARTY and is NOT licensed,
  registered or supervised by any financial regulator.
- Not available to US, EU/EEA, UK or BVI persons.
- Not insurance, not a deposit, not investment advice.
- Capital at risk: the entire premium can be lost; amounts owed are an unsecured
  claim against a small unlicensed company; no secondary market; no cancellation
  before expiry.

Access is by request only: email with the position and jurisdiction. There is no
purchase button.
